answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 1499 Country: India Title: People say to me after wuzu if I see the mirror & comb to my hair my wuzu breaks. Please, tell correct information. (2) If lady has a nail polis on her nail. she can completed her namoz or not? Question: (1) People say to me after wuzu if I see the mirror & comb to my hair my wuzu breaks. Please, tell correct information. (2) If lady has a nail polis on her nail. she can completed her namoz or not? Answer ID: 1499 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 857/857=J) (1) The wuzu is not nullified by looking at mirror or by combing. There is no mentioning of such things in Islamic Fiqh. (2) If the nail polish prevents water from reaching the skin then the wuzu will be void. When the wuzu will not take place salah will automatically not be valid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
